title: github_core SBOM attestation collector config
description: Which image digests the SBOM attestation collector reads, and where its default-deny trust list lives (req-github-core-sbom-attestations-1). Operator-owned and off-grid: the file sits beside the collector credential under TAP_SECRETS_ROOT. No image name is built into the plugin; an empty subjects list is invalid.

_description.description: Human and AI readable purpose of this config file.

format.description: Format discriminator; bumped on a breaking shape change.

trusted_signers_path.description: Absolute path of the trust list (tap's scripts/sbom/trusted-signers.json, format tap-sbom-trusted-signers/1). Read at the start of every run; an unreadable, invalid or empty list refuses the run. Never defaulted.

on_unverified_attestation.description: What to do when GitHub lists more CycloneDX attestations for a subject than the trusted signers verified: record a warning (warn) or stop the run before anything is submitted (abort). The unverified ones are never read either way.

verifier.description: Who checks the signature chain. sigstore_core (default) verifies each bundle in process with the sigstore_core plugin under a policy built from the trust list entry; gh runs `gh attestation verify` per trust list entry and needs the gh CLI on PATH. Both are held to the trust list again afterwards.

batch_name.description: Name of the GRIFT batch the run submits.

subjects.description: The image digests whose attestations are read. Each is one attested subject: a per-architecture manifest digest, because that is what CI signs. Image tags are never resolved here (a tag is mutable).

_description.description: What this subject is and why it is read.

image.description: The image repository without tag or digest, e.g. ghcr.io/<owner>/<name>. The second path segment is the owner whose attestations are read.

digest.description: The manifest digest the attestations are about.
